input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
errors: Backgrounded the first bench with a trailing '&' inside run_in_background, so the harness notified at once and the process ran untracked; polled with until-loops instead.
A first wait loop matched the bench's header line ('80 people ...') as a data row.

doc_friction.issue: Checked ps.error, which parseShifts never sets (it returns errors[]), so a refused 120-person week printed a zero row marked proven; fixed in this PR.
The '80-120 person weeks' item did not say that 120x336 is over the tool's 400-shift cap; the item cost a run to find that out.

deviations.why: The top Deepen row (ai-bookkeeper) has 74 commits in 7 days, and its first open item needs the AI layer or real outside books. I took flagship 6 (shift-roster-builder), whose next item could be done here.
deviations.result: Landed a measured algorithmic slice (root LP now finishes at 80 people).

writeups: ventures/shift-roster-builder/README.md (A chain bound in the pricing oracle)
notes: Bench output in ventures/shift-roster-builder/eval/cg-scale-bench.out.txt. 80x224 before: root unfinished at 120 s, oracle 108 of 121 s, max call 577,737 nodes. After: max call 11.8k-57k nodes, 1 of 3 proven (281 h, 96 s), 2 rosters 4-5 h over the bound. 60x168 same-session control: 22-31 s off vs 12-22 s on, same search path. Local verification: python3 platform/ci/run_venture_tests.py shift-roster-builder -> ok (428.8 s); node --test chain-bound.test.mjs 2/2. node platform/pages/venture-preflight.mjs shift-roster-builder -> preflight clean.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: an optimisation engineer diagnosing the oracle, deriving and testing the Lagrangian chain bound, and benching 60/80-person weeks

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
